text.body: || śābdikābharaṇam‌|| (bhūmikā-bhāgaḥ) vidyānidhiṃ namaskṛtya sarvadevamayaṃ harim‌| śābdikānāmalaṅkāraḥ kriyate hariyoginā|| atha śabdānuśāsanam‌, keṣāṃ śabdānāṃ laukikānāṃ vaidikānāṃ ca, atha kimātmakaṃ śabdamabhyupagamya idaṃ śabdānuśāsanamārabhyate, tāvadvarṇātmakamiti brūmaḥ, varṇāḥ punaranityā nityā vā, tāvannityā iti vadāmaḥ| kuta eṣāṃ nityatāvagatiḥ, pratyabhijñānāt‌ tathāhi yamahamaśrauṣaṃ yakāraṃ tametarhi śṛṇomīti| pratisandhānamutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, na cedamanityatve varṇānāṃ ghaṭate| arthapratītyanyathopapattyā ca varṇānāṃ nityatvam abhyupagantavyam‌| tathāhi kṣaṇikatve varṇānāṃ samudāyābhāve saṅketasya asambhavāt‌ tatpūrvikā śabdādarthapratipattiranupapannā syāt‌| naitadasti, pratyabhijñānasyānadhigatārthagantṛtve prāmāṇyābhāvāt‌| anadhigatārthagantṛ pramāṇamiti prāmāṇyasāmānyalakṣaṇābhidhānāt‌| athānadhigatārthagantṛ pratyabhijñānam‌, tanna, adṛṣṭārthatāyāṃ mithyātvaprasaṅgāt‌| atha dhīrūpeṇādhigatārthamapīdānīntanadeśa-kālādyanapekṣayā'nadhigatārthañceti| nanu evamapi ubhayadoṣātinipātaprasaṅgaḥ, prameyasamagryāṃ ca deśakālāderabhāvābhyupagamenādhigatārthatvameva, tāvataḥ prameyasya pūrvamapratipatteḥ, na ca śrotravyāpāreṇa deśakālādergrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam‌| atha pramāṇasāmagryam‌ antarbhāvaḥ| tarhi pramāṇasyānityatve'pi prameye tādavasthyādadhigatārthaviṣayatvameva sarvatra prameyabhedādeva vijñānabheda ityabhyupagame pratijñānamanyatāyāṃ kṣaṇikatāprasaṅgaḥ| tasmādanadhigatārthaviṣayatvameva sarvapramāṇamityevaṃvādinaḥ apramāṇam eva pratyabhijñānam‌| kiñca channobhūteṣu keśanakhādiṣu sādṛśyavaśāt‌ pratyabhijñānaṃ sāmānyādau cārthatathābhāvāditi dvaividhyopalabdherviśeṣānupalabdhau sandigdhatvād. aprāmāṇyam‌| atha varṇasya śravaṇānantaramanupalabdhirvyañjakābhāvānnāsatvāditi cet‌ na, sadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt‌| abhyupagame vā kvacit‌ pradeśe śabdasyābhivyaktau tasya vyāpakatayā sarvadeśāvasthitapuruṣāṇām‌ upalambhaḥ syāt‌, athaikadeśāstasyābhi-vyajyante, teṣāmabhede śabdasyābhivyaktiriti tadeva dūṣaṇam‌, bhede tu tadabhivyaktau kathaṃ śabdo'rthamabhidadhyāt‌, avegavaśāt‌ bheridaṇḍasaṃyogāpekṣādutpannakriyo vāyurvegavān‌ śrotradeśenāgatyābhisambadhyate tadgatāni stimitavāyvantarāṇyapanayati tataḥ pratibandhakābhāve sati śrotravarṇagrāhakamiti, nanvevamadoṣaḥ śabdopalambhaprasaṅgaḥ, saṃskṛte hi śrotre sarveṣāṃ sānnidhyāt‌| na ca gośabdābhivyakttyartham‌ utpāditaprerito vāyurnāśvaṃ vaktīti vācyam‌| vyañjakeṣu niyamānupalabdheḥ, yathā ghaṭādivyakttyartham utpāditaḥ pradīpaḥ samānendriyagrāhyaḥ samānadeśāvasthitapadārthābhivyañjaka iti, tadevamabhivyaktipakṣe varṇānāṃ bādhakopapatteḥ| arthapratīteranyathāpi bhāvācca, nityatvapratipādanaṃ nirālambanameva| anityāstarhi varṇāḥ kathaṃ teṣāmanityatā, utpannapradhvaṃsitvāt‌, etacca kuto'vasīyate, pratyuccāraṇamanyathābhāvenānubhūya-mānatvāt‌, tathāhi pratyakṣamanupalabhyamāno'pi puruṣaviśeṣo'dhyayadhvaniśravaṇādeva viśeṣato nirdhāryate, devadatto'yamadhīte, yajñadatto'yamadhīta iti| na ceyaṃ varṇaviṣayānyathā pratītirmithyājñānamiti viveditavyam bādhakapratyayābhāvāt‌, nanvasti bādhakapratyayaḥ, ta evādivarṇeṣu prakīrṇā iti pratyabhijñānam‌, neyaṃ varṇaviṣayā pratyabhijñeti vācyam‌, nityatvapakṣe varṇānāṃ bādhakasyopapāditatvāt, kiṃ tarhi tadākṛti, viṣayā yathā anyonyavisadṛśīṣu govyaktiṣu saiveyamityanusandhānaṃ jātyālambanam evamabādhyamānānyathāpratyayaviṣayabhūteṣu varṇeṣu pratisandhānamutpādyamānaṃ varṇākṛtimevāvalambya prathata iti yuktam‌, tathāhi saṅketottarakālaṃ gavādiṣu gotvādivadvarṇeṣu tadākṛtiḥ pratibhāsate| ata eva dambherhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāt‌ siddhaṃ dhipsatītyākṛtinirdeśāt‌ siddhamityādi-bhāṣyakāravacanamupapannaṃ bhavati, astu tarhi kathaṃ teṣāṃ hi vācakatvaṃ na pratyeka-vācakatvaṃ vyabhicārāt‌, tathā hi na pratyekaṃ varṇānām‌ arthavattā'sti, yadi syāt‌, dhanaṃ vanamityatra nāntasyārthavatvena prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ subutpattau padasaṃjñāyāṃ saṃjñā dvayanibandhano nalopaḥ syāt‌, visaṃbusamityatra sāntasyāta eva hetoḥ sasajuṣoruriti rutvaṃ syāt‌ ityevamādayo doṣāḥ prasajyeran‌| api ca kūpaḥ sūpo yūpa ityatrānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kakārasakārayākārāṇām‌ evārthavattvaṃ pratīyate netarayoḥ kathaṃ karmakāraḥ vṛkaḥ śukaḥ ityatra pūrvottarabhāvena vyavasthitasya kakārasyaivārthavatvam‌ anvayavyatirekasiddhaṃ netarasya, tasmānna pratyekamarthavanto varṇāḥ na ca samudāyapratyayaḥ asti teṣāṃ krameṇānutpādyamānatvāt‌, tathāhi vāgindriyamaṣṭasthānavibhaktam‌ udānena vāyunābhihanyamānaṃ krameṇa varṇān‌ karoti, tathā ca śikṣākāravacanam - ātmā buddhyā ca sāmarthyāt mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā| manaḥ kāyāgnimāhanti sa prerayati mārutam‌|| aṣṭau sthānāni varṇānāmuraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śirastathā| jihvāmūlaṃ ca dantāśca nāsikoṣṭhau ca tālu ca|| iti| evamekasmin‌ varṇe jāte naṣṭe aparasya janmanāśāvapītyanena krameṇaikakalānavasthānām varṇānāṃ samudāyapratyayābhāvaḥ| atha yadi brūyāḥ pūrvavarṇānubhavasaṃskārasacivasya vācakatvamiti, manorathamātrametat‌| tathāhi- sambandhagrahaṇamapekṣamāṇaḥ śabdastvayaṃ pratīyamāno'rthaṃ pratyāyayitumīṣṭe dhūmādivat‌, na hi dhūmaḥ svayamanupalabhyamāno'gnimanumāpayituṃ śaknoti| na ca pūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasahitasya caramavarṇasya pratītirasti saṃskārāṇāmapratyakṣatvāt saṃskārāṇāṃ pratyakṣatāyāmapi kāryapratyāyitaistaiḥ padasya vācakatvamabhyupagantavyam‌| atha kimarthapratītyanyathānupapatyā sphoṭaḥ kalpyate utopalabhyate, na kalpayāmyahaṃ, sphoṭapratyakṣaṃ cainamavagacchāmi, ekaivavarṇagrahaṇāhitavāṅkṣāyāmantyavarṇapratyakṣajanitavipākāyāṃ buddhāvayavavipratyayavadakhaṇḍitākāratayā gauriti pratibhāsanāt‌ samastavarṇaviṣayajñānametaditi vaktuṃ yuktaṃ kṣaṇikatvena varṇānāṃ sāmastyāsambhavāt‌| ayamantyavarṇapratyaya iti ca na vācyam‌, gauriti pratīteḥ| varṇākṛtiviṣayatā ca durotsāritā ananuvṛttasvabhāvatvāt‌, tasya ca yadetadvarṇebhyo'tyantamabhinnatvaṃ tadvarṇadvāreṇaiva pratīyamānatvāt‌ gavādivyaktidvāreṇa gotvādivat‌, sa yadā gakārādivarṇāgrahaṇāhitasaṃskārayā buddhyā paricchidyate tadā tadākāra ivāvabhāsate| sa eva yadākārādivarṇānubhavajanitavāsanayā dhiyā viṣayīkriyate tadā tadrūpa iva bhavati sa ca pratyuccāraṇaṃ pratyabhijñāyamānatvāt‌ ākṛtivannityaḥ| nanu nityaścet‌ kimiti sarvadā nopalabhyate, tadabhivyañjakasya varṇakalāpasyānityatvāt, nanu kathaṃ varṇānāmabhivyañjakatvaṃ, tathāhi samastairabhivyajyate kṣaṇikatvena samudāyānābhyupagamāt‌ avyastairekenābhivyaktau śeṣoccāraṇavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt‌| ucyate- yadyapi varṇānāṃ kṣaṇikatayā sākṣādabhivyañjakatvaṃ na sambhavati tathāpi gakārādivarṇoccāraṇa-samanantaraṃ gaurityabhinnabuddhiviṣayasya śabdasya pratibhāsanāt‌ praṇālīkayā teṣāmavyañjakatvaṃ niścīyate| tathā coktam‌- nādairāhitabījāyāmantyena dhvaninā saha| āvṛttaparipākāyāṃ buddhau śabdo'vadhāryate|| iti | aparaṃ ca sphoṭanirūpaṇaparaṃ vacanaṃ tadidamekabuddhiviṣayaṃ ekaprayatnākṣiptam‌ abhāgamakramaṃ avarṇaṃ bauddham‌ antyavarṇapratyayavyāpāropasthāpitamiti| asyārthaḥ- tatpadaṃ bauddhaṃ mānasamekaṃ nānekaṃ, kasmāt‌, yasmādekabuddhiviṣayaṃ yasmādekaprayatnākṣiptam‌, kutaḥ, yasmādabhāgamaṃśarahitaṃ, kasmādabhāgaṃ, yasmādakramaṃ yasmādavarṇaṃ kasmādavarṇaṃ, yasmādbauddhaṃ, kasmāt‌ bauddhaṃ yasmād. antyavarṇapratyayavyāpāropasthāpitaṃ tasmādantyavarṇapratyayavyāpāropasthāpitatvāt‌ avarṇamavarṇatvāt akramamakramatvāt‌ anāgamamanāgatvāt‌ ekaprayatnākṣiptam ekaprayatnākṣiptatvādekabuddhiviṣayamekabuddhiviṣayatvāt‌ ekaṃ padaṃ yattad bauddhaṃ padamiti| sūkṣmaṃ, tatkathaṃ loke pratīyate, taducyate- puruṣāntarapratipādaviṣayā varṇairevābhidhīyamānaiḥ śrūyamāṇaiśca śrotṛbhiranādivāgvyavahārajanite vāsanāvāsitayā lokabuddhyā vṛddhebhyo bālānām ityanayā saṃpradāyaparamparayā prasiddhamivapratīyate| yata evaṃ tasmādanādivāsanaivātmani dehādāvātmabuddheḥ nitya iva varṇeṣu śabdabuddheḥ śaraṇam‌| tathā varṇaireva padābhivyaktiriti lokabhrāntyā laukikairvarṇādvarṇeṣveva vācakatvamāsajyate| nanu tasya stimitamahodadhikalpasya śabdatattvasya kutaḥ pravibhāgaḥ utaitasya padasya varṇākāreṇāvasthitasyaitāvatā varṇānāmanena krameṇāvasthito vinyāsa etasyārthasya vācaka iti paropadeśajanitārthasaṅketa-buddhivibhāgāt‌ pravibhāgāt‌ pravibhāgaḥ| dṛśyate ca loke saṅketabuddhibhedādabhinnasyāpi vastuno bhedavyavahārahetutvam‌| tadyathā devadattasyaikasya pitṛputrapautrabhrātṛjāmātṛ-buddhibhedavaśena bhedavyapadeśabhāgitvam‌| nanu kṣaṇikatve sati varṇānāṃ kathaṃ saṅketaviṣayatvopapattiḥ, viśiṣṭānupūrvasacivatayā teṣāṃ saṅketaviṣayatvamupapadyata ityadoṣaḥ, tathā tadekameva śabdabrahma kūṭasthaṃ nityaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ caitanyaṃ tasyaiva vivarta viviktaḥ pariṇāmo vā jagadidaṃ sarvamiti manyante| śabdādvaitavādino vaiyākaraṇāḥ, tathāhi- śabdasaṃpṛktapratibhāsa eva vivartaḥ| pramāṇam‌, ‘sarva evārtho viśiṣṭanāmadheyaviśiṣṭaṃ parisphurati yatrāpi viśiṣṭanāmādheyābhāvastatrāpi kiṃ yattadādiśabdairvyapadeśaḥ sambhavatyeva, tathā jñānaṃ ca. śabdānuviddhaṃ pratibhāsate, taduktaṃ ca- na sosti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte| anuviddhamiva jñānaṃ sarvaṃ śabdena bhāsate|| iti| yadi gauriyaṃ ghaṭo'yamiti, evaṃ vimarśo na syāt‌, tadā jñānamapi na bhavet‌| taduktam‌- vāgrūpatā cedutkrāmamedavabodhasya śāsvatī| na prakāśaḥ prakāśeta sā hi pratyavamarśinī|| iti| na ca śabdānuviddhena jñānena pratibhāsamānānām‌ apyaśabdātmakatvam arthānāmiti, sāmprataṃ rūpādirūpatvenāpi tadasiddhiprasaṅgāt‌, na caiṣa śabdollekhaḥ spaṣṭatvādivadvijñānadharmarūpollekhasamānakakṣyatayā pratibhāsanāt‌, yathā hi śuklaṃ vastraṃ śuklo guṇa iti śuklaviśiṣṭaḥ parisphurati, tathā śuklaśabdaviśiṣṭo'pi parisphuratītyubhayorapi siddhirasiddhirvā syāt‌, samānanyāyatvāt‌, yattu gaurayamiti saṃvedane'pi na gauḥ śabdoyamiti pratipattirasau śabdāṃśabhedāt‌, evamanyatrāpīti, tasmācchrotreṇa grahaṇamavasthābhedādeva tathā coktam‌- vaikharī śabdaniṣpattirmadhyamā śrutigocarā| dyotitārtha ca paśyantī sūkṣmā vāganapāyinī|| iti| asyārthaḥ śabdānniṣpattiryasyāsau śabdaniṣpattiḥ ghaṭādirūpapariṇāmo vaikharī śrutigocarā śrotragrāhyā madhyamādyotitaḥ prakāśito'rtho yasyāḥ sā dyotitārthā jñānarūpā paśyantī gīyate, anapāyinī brahmarūpeṇa sūkṣmeti gīyate| tathā coktam‌- śabdabrahma yadekaṃ caitanyaṃ ca sarvabhūtānām‌| yatpariṇāmaṃ tribhuvanaṃ akhilamidaṃ jayati sā vāṇī|| śrutirapi ca- catvāri vākparimitāpadāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ| guhā trīṇi hitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti| iti| sthūlasūkṣmabhāvenāvasthitasya pravaṇasya śabdabrahmātmakatvaṃ darśayati akāro vai sarvāvāk| saiṣā sparśoṣmabhirvyajyamānā bahvī nānārūpā bhavati cetyalamatiprapañcena| nanvevaṃ tarhi kathamitthambhāvamupagatastasya śabdasyānuśāsanamupapadyate prakṛtyādivibhāgakalpanayeti brūmaḥ| nanu lokādeva laukikāḥ siddhāḥ| vedācca vaidikāḥ ityanarthakaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ tathāhi kaścidghaṭena kāryaṃ kariṣyan‌ kulālakulaṃ gatvā bravīti kuru ghaṭamanena kāryaṃ kariṣyāmīti| na tathā śabdān‌ prayuṅkṣamāṇo vaiyākaraṇakulaṃ gatvā hi kuru śabdān‌ prayokṣya iti| taṃ tamevārthamupādāya śabdān‌ prayuñjate| ucyate ‘siddhe śabdārthasambandhe śāstreṇa dharmaniyamaḥ kriyate kimidaṃ dharmaniyama iti, dharmāyaniyamo dharmaniyamaḥ| tadyathā- loke vede ca| loke tāvat‌ abhakṣyāḥ grāmyakukkuṭaḥ abhakṣyo grāmyasūkara ityucyate| bhakṣyaṃ ca nāma kṣutpratighātārthamupādīyate| śakyaṃ cānena śvamāṃsādibhirapi kṣutpratihantum‌| tatra niyamaḥ kriyate idaṃ bhakṣyamidamabhakṣyamiti| tathā khedāstrīṣu pravṛttirbhavati| samānaśca khedavigamo gamyāyāmagamyāyāṃ ca| tatra niyamaḥ kriyate| iyaṃ gamyeyamagamyeti| tathā vede payovrato brāhmaṇaḥ| yavāgūvrato rājanyaḥ| amikṣāvrato vaiśyaḥ| vrataṃ nāmābhyavahārārtham‌ upādīyate| śakyaṃ cānena śālimāṃsānyapi vratayituṃ tatra niyamaḥ kriyate tathā vailvaḥ khadiro vā yūpaḥ syādityucyate| yūpaśca nāma paśvanubandhanārthamupādīyate| śakyaṃ cānena kiñcitkāṣṭhamucchrityānucchritya vā paśuranubandhuṃ tatra ca niyamaḥ kriyate| tathāgnau kapālānyadhiśrityanenānumantrayate ‘bhṛgūṇāmaṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyadhvamiti' antareṇāpi mantramagnirdāhakarmā kapālāni santāpayati| tatra ca niyamaḥ kriyate| evaṃ kriyamāṇamabhyudayakāri bhavatīti| evamihāpi samānāyāmarthāvagatau śabdenāpaśabdena ca dharmaniyamaḥ kriyate| śabdenaivārtho'bhidheyo bhavati nāpaśabdeneti| evaṃ kriyamāṇamabhyudayakārī bhavati| santi cāprayuktāḥ śabdāḥ, yadyapyete aprayuktāstathāpi dīrghasatravat lakṣaṇenānuvidhātavyāḥ| tadyathā dīrghasatrāṇi vārṣaśatikāni vārṣasahasrikāṇi natvadyatve kaścidadhyāharati| kevalaṃ tu ṛṣisampradāyo dharma iti kṛtvā yājñikaḥ śāstreṇānuvidadhate| api ca ete śabdā deśāntareṣu prayujyante| na copalabhyante| upalabdhau yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ| mahān‌ śabdasya viṣayaḥ| saptadvīpā vasumatī trayo lokāścatvāro vedāḥ sāṅgāḥ sarahasyā bahudhā bhinnā ekaśatamadhvaryoḥ śākhāḥ sahastravartmā sāmavedaḥ| ekaviṃśatidhā bāhvṛcyaṃ navadhātharvaṇo vedaḥ, vākovākyamitihāsaḥ purāṇaṃ vaidyakamityetāvān‌ śabdasya prayogaviṣayaḥ| atha punaḥ śabdasya jñāne dharmaḥ, āhosvit‌ prayoge kaścātra viśeṣaḥ| jñāne dharma iti cedadharmaśca prāpnoti| yo hi śabdaṃ jānāti, apaśabdānapyasau jānāti| yathaiva śabdajñāne dharmaḥ evamapaśabdajñānepyadharmaḥ| athavā bhūyānadharmaḥ prāpnoti| bhūyāṃso'paśabdāḥ alpīyāṃsaḥ śabdāḥ| yasmādekasya hi śabdasya bahavo'pabhraṃśāḥ| astu tarhi ācāre niyamamṛrṣivedayate| te'surā helaya iti kurvantaḥ parābabhūvuḥ| tasmād. brāhmaṇena na mlecchitavai nāpabhāṣitavyaṃ ‘mleccho ha vā eṣa apaśabda iti| astu tarhi prayoge dharmaḥ sarvelokobhyudayena yujyate| kaścedānīṃ bhavato matsaroḥ yadi sarvalokobhyudayena yujyate na khalu kaścinmatsaraḥ prayatnārthakyaṃ tu bhavati, phalavatā ca nāma prayatnena bhavitavyam‌| na prayatnaḥ phalādvyatirecyaḥ| nanu ca ye kṛtayatnāḥ te sādhīyāṃsaḥ śabdān‌ prayokṣyante| ta eva sādhīyo'bhyudayena yokṣyante| vyatireko'pi lakṣyate kṛtayatnāścāpravīṇāḥ akṛtayatnāśca pravīṇāḥ tatra phalavyatireko'pi syāt‌| evaṃ tarhi jñāne nāpi prayoga eva| kiṃ tarhi jñānapūrvake prayoge'bhyudayena yathā vedaśabdā niyamapūrvakamadhītāḥ phalavanto bhavanti| evaṃ yaḥ śāstrapūrvakān‌ śabdān‌ prayuṅkte so'bhyudayena yujyate| tathā coktam‌ yadadhītamavijñātaṃ nigadenaiva śabdyate| anagnāviva śuṣkaidho na tajjvalati karhicit‌|| ‘‘duṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ svarato varṇato vā mithyā prayukto na tamarthamāha| sa vāgvajro yajamānaṃ hinasti yathendraśatruḥ svaratoparādhāditi|'' kiṃ ca rakṣohāgamalaghvasandehāḥ prayojanam‌| purākalpa etadāsīt‌ ‘‘saṃskārottarakālaṃ brāhmaṇā vyākaraṇaṃ smādhīyate tebhyaḥ sthānakaraṇānupradānajñebhyaḥ tata uttarakālaṃ vaidikāḥ śabdā upadiśyante, tadadyatve na tathā| tathā vedamadhītya tvaritā vaktāro bhavanti| vedānno vaidikāḥ siddhāḥ lokācca laukikāḥ| anarthakaṃ vyākaraṇamiti tebhya evaṃvipratipannabuddhibhyo'dhyetṛbhya ācāryaḥ prayojanāni vyācaṣṭe imāni prayojanāni nityamadhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇamiti| tatra rakṣā tāvat‌ lopāgamavarṇavikārajño hi vedān paripālayiṣyati| ūhaḥ khalvapi na savairliṅ‌gairna sarvābhirvibhaktibhirvede mantrā nigaditāḥ| tānnāvaiyākaraṇaḥ śaknoti vipariṇamayitum‌| āgamaḥ khalvapi brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇo dharmaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedodhyetavya iti| prathamaṃ ca ṣaḍṣvaṅgeṣu vyākaraṇam‌ pradhānameva| pradhāne ca kṛto yatnaḥ phalavān‌ bhavati| phalārthaścādhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam‌| laghvarthaṃ cādhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam| brāhmaṇena śabdā jñeyā iti| na cāntareṇa vyākaraṇaṃ laghunopāyāntareṇa śabdāḥ śakyā jñātum‌| asandehārthaṃ cādhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam‌| yājñikāḥ paṭhanti ḥ - sthūlapṛṣatīmāgnivāruṇīmanaḍvāhīmālabheteti| tasyāṃ sandehaḥ sthūlā pṛṣatī sthūlapṛṣatī sthūlāni pṛṣantyasyāḥ sthūlapṛṣatī tānnāvaiyākaraṇaḥ svarato vyavasyati| yadi pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ tato bahubrīhiḥ| athāntodāttattvaṃ tatastatpuruṣa iti| nāmākhyātapadasārūpyādapyasti sandehaḥ, tadyathā bhavatyaśvo'jāpayaḥ iti bhavati śabda ākhyātikaḥ kriyāvācakaḥ prathamapuruṣasyaikavacanam‌, asti vidyate bhavatīti, tathā kāraka vācakaḥ saptamyekavacanaṃ bhavati| tvayi ṭuośvigativṛddhyoriti madhyamaikavacane sipi śapi cliluṅītyadhikṛtyāsyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ‌ iti vartamāne ‘jṛstambha0' ityādināṅi ca kṛte śvayateḥ ityatve cāto guṇe ca pararūpatve cāḍāgame rutvavisargayoraśvo vṛddhavān kriyāvācakaḥ| tathā śruvṛṣi kaṇigañiviśiṣkvanityauṇādikaḥ kārakavācako'śvaśabdaḥ japerṇyanta laṅi madhyamaikavacane sicyaḍāgame kṛte satyajāpayaḥ japaṅkāritavānasīti kriyāvācakaḥ iti| nākhyātaṃ padam‌ ajāyāḥ payo'jāpaya iti kārakavācakam‌| tathā tena iti, tanoterliṭi madhyamabahuvacane dvirvacanaitvābhyāsalopeṣu satsu kriyāvācakam‌, tṛtīyaikavacane tu kārakamiti nāmākhyātasādṛśyam‌ tathā vacanasādṛśyaṃ cāsti| tadyathā te ityukte tava ityekavacanam‌, dvivacanaṃ te kule iti, bahuvacanaṃ te puruṣā iti tasmādasaṃdehārthamadhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam‌|| dhātupratyayapañjikā dīpajvālācalairvarṇairabhivyañjitamañjasā| sphoṭāhvayamahaṃ vande rūpaṃ viṣṇorguhāśayam‌|| bāleṣu pāṇinīyābdhipraveśabhṛśabhīruṣu| mayaitadantarviṣṭena kṣipyante śabdabindavaḥ|| svarūpamarthaṃ dhātūnāṃ vyavasthāmapi tiṅvidheḥ| vaktuṃ vaiyākaraṇabhedamayamasmat‌ samudyamaḥ|| tatra tāvaddhātvarthaviśeṣadvāreṇa lakārotpattiṃ prati nimittabhūtaḥ kālaḥ upadiśyate| sa ca nitvādyāpitvāccākāśakalpaḥ| eko'pi yadyapi kālaḥ tathāpi vartamāno bhūto bhaviṣyanniti ye vyapadeśabhedāḥ, te tasya kriyādvārakāḥ| sa ca kālo mūrtimadbhiḥ sarvairavayavaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ| tatsaṃyukteṣu dravyeṣu kriyāyāpi bhedo'pi samavaitīti saṃyuktena samavāyena kriyāgato vartamānādivyavahāraḥ upacārāt‌ kāle pravartate| yathaikasmin‌ puruṣe kriyābhedādanekāḥ saṃjñā dṛśyante| taduktam‌- yathaikasmin‌ kriyābhedāt‌ tadādyākhyā pravartate| kriyābhedāttathaikasmin‌ bhūtādyākhyā pravartate|| ādigrahaṇena vartamānādergrahaṇam‌| sa ca bhūtādibhedena trividho'pi śabdavyutpatyarthamāryairanekadhā kalpitaḥ| tadyathā bhūtasāmānyaṃ bhūtaviśeṣāśca| ke punaste viśeṣāḥ vartamānasamīpabhūtaḥ anadyatanabhūtaḥ| aharubhayatardharātrādeṣo'nadyatana kāla iti kecit‌| atītāyāśca rātreḥ paścimo yāmaḥ āgāminyāśca rātreḥ prathamo yāmo divasaḥ sa kāla eṣo'dyatanakālaḥ ityanye| tatpratiṣedhenānadyatanaḥ| tataḥ parokṣānadyatanabhūtaḥ| tatraiva lokavijñātavaktṛdarśanayogyaḥ parokṣānadyatanabhūt‌ iti, kriyāprabandhānadyatanabhūtaḥ, sāmīpyānadyatanabhūtaḥ, rātriviśeṣe jāgaraṇaṃ santyanadyatanabhūtaḥ adyatanānadyatanavyāmiśrabhūta iti| vartamānaḥ punareka eva| kecidāhuḥ- pravṛttoparataścaiva vṛttāvirata eva ca| nityapravṛttaḥ sāmīpyo vartamānaścaturvidhaḥ|| iti| pravṛttoparato yathā anṛtaṃ na bhāṣate| vṛttāvirataḥ prāsādaṃ karoti| nityapravṛttaḥ tiṣṭhanti parvatāḥ| sāmīpyo dvividhaḥ, bhūtasāmīpyo bhaviṣyatsāmīpyaśca| pūrvaṃ vartamānagrahaṇena bhūtabhaviṣyantau viśeṣitau idānīṃ tu tābhyāṃ vartamāna iti śeṣaḥ viśeṣitaḥ| kadā devadatta āgatosi| eṣa āgacchāmi| āgacchantameva māṃ viddhi| ayamamahamagamaḥ, eṣo'smyāgataḥ| kadā devadatta āgamiṣyasi| eṣa āgacchāmi| agacchantameva māṃ viddhi| āgamiṣyāmi| āgantāsmi| atraitānyevodāharaṇāni| tathā bhaviṣyatsāmānyaṃ bhaviṣyadviśeṣāśceti| ke punarviśeṣāḥ| anadyatanabhaviṣyadvartamānasamīpabhaviṣyanmuhūrtopari bhaviṣyatkriyāprabandhānadyatanabhaviṣyat-sāmīpyānadyatanabhaviṣyadāśaṃsā bhaviṣyadadyatanānadyatanavyāmiśrabhaviṣyan iti| tatra bhūtasāmānye luṅ‌ iti luṅ‌vad bhavati tatraiva vartamānasamīpabhūte ‘vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadve'ti atideśāllaṅluṅau bhavataḥ| anadyatanabhūte tu ‘anadyatane laṅi'ti laṅ‌vidhiḥ tatraivābhijñāvacanelṛḍiti lṛḍ‌ bhavati| abhijānāsi tatra vatsyāvaḥ| parokṣānadyatanabhūte parokṣe liḍiti liṭ‌| tatraiva lokavijñāte lāntasya śabdasya prayoktuḥ śakyadarśane kāryāntaravyāsaṅgādadarśane sati parokṣe laṅupasaṃkhyāyate liḍapavādaḥ| tatraivottamaviṣaye cittavikṣepapratyakṣe'pi liḍupasaṃkhyāyate| kecidāhuḥ- kṛtasya smaraṇe karturatyantāpahnave'pi ca| karmakartroradṛśyatve triṣu vidyāt‌ parokṣatām‌|| iti| kṛtasya smaraṇe karturyathā supto'haṃ kila vilalāpa| atyantāpahnave tvayā kaliṅgeṣu sukhamuṣitamityukte nāhaṃ kaliṅgān‌ jagāmeti| karmakartroradṛśyatve jaghāna kaṃsaṃ kila vāsudevaḥ| kriyāprabandhaḥ kriyāṇāṃ sātatyenānuṣṭhānam‌, kālānāṃ sāmīpyaṃ tulyajātīyenāvyavadhānaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ bhṛśamannamadāt‌| yāvajjīvaṃ bhṛśamannaṃ dāsyatīti kriyāpratyayaḥ| sāmīpyaṃ tu yeyaṃ paurṇamāsyatikrāntāḥ etasyāmupādhyāyaḥ agnīnādadhīta| somenāyaṣṭa| yeyaṃ paurṇamāsyāgāminī tasyāmupādhyāyaḥ agnīnādhāsyati somena yakṣyata iti laṅ‌luṭoḥ prāptayoḥ luṅ‌lṛṭau vidhīyete| rātriśeṣe jāgaraṇaṃ sātatyenādyatanabhūte tu vasereva dhātoluṅvidhīyate| atyantāpahnavānadyatanabhūte tūdāhṛtaḥ| adyatanānadyatana vyāmiśrabhūte tu adyahyavetyevaṃ rūpe bhūtasāmānnyavihito luṅ‌ vidhīyate| tathā bhaviṣyat‌ sāmānye ‘lṛṭ‌ śeṣe' ceti lṛṭ‌ bhavati| tatraiva yāvat‌ purāśabdopapadatve yāvat‌ purā nipātayorlaḍiti laṭ‌| kadā karhi śabdopapadatve vibhāṣā kadā karhyoriti vibhāṣā| kiṃ vṛttelipsāyāmiti vibhaktyante ḍataraḍatamānte ca kiṃ śabda upapade lipsāyāṃ gamyamānāṃ vibhāṣā laḍ‌ bhavati| tatraiva lipsyamānasiddhau gamyamānāyāṃ vā laḍvidhiḥ| loḍartha lakṣaṇe ca loḍarthaḥ praiṣādikarma lakṣyate| yena dhātvarthena tatra vartamānāddhātorbhaviṣyatkāle vibhāṣā laṭ‌ pratyayo bhavati| tasminneva viṣaye muhūrtopari bhaviṣyatkāle vibhāṣā liṅcordhvamauhūrtika iti liṅ‌ cakārāllaṭ‌ ca| vibhāṣā tābhyāmutpatte lṛṅ‌lṛṭāvapi bhavataḥ| bhaviṣyadyanadyatane tu anadyatane luḍiti luṭ‌| vartamānasamīpa-bhaviṣyatyudāharaṇaṃ darśitam‌| kriyāprabandhānadyatanabhaviṣyati tatsāmīpyabhaviṣyati ca nānadyatanavadityādinā luṭaḥ pratiṣedhāt‌ lṛḍeva bhavati| aśaṃsābhaviṣyati vartamānasāmīpyetyadhikāre āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacceti bhūtavadvartamānavacca luṅ‌luṭau bhavataḥ| adyatanānadyatana vyāmiśrabhaviṣyatyadya śvo vetyevaṃrūpe lṛḍeva bhavati| tathā garhāyāṃ laḍapi jātvoḥ iti jātuśabdopapadatve garhāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ kālasāmānye kālaviśeṣavihitān‌ pratyāyān‌ bādhitvā laḍvidhānam‌ vibhāṣā kathaṃ liṅceti| kathaṃśabda upapade garhāyāmeva liṅ‌ bhavati cakārāt‌ laṭ‌| vibhāṣāgrahaṇādyathā svakālavihitā api pratyayā bhavanti| kiṃ vṛtterliṅ‌lṛṭāvityanena sūtreṇa vibhaktyante ḍataraḍatamānte ca kiṃ śabda upapade garhāyāmeva nityaṃ liṅ‌lṛṭau pratyayau bhavataḥ| tathā anavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛtte'pi anavaklṛptirasaṃbhāvanā amarṣaḥ akṣamā tayorarthayoḥ kiṃ vṛtte cākiṃ vṛtte ca liṅ‌liṭāveva vidhīyete| tathā hetuhetumatorarthayorvartamānāddhātoḥ hetuhetumatorliṅityanena liṅ‌ vidhīyate| vibhāṣeyamiṣyate bhaviṣyati kāle ca| evaṃ vibhāṣā kathamiliṅ‌ cetyārabhya yāvaddhetuhetumatorliṅityetat‌ sūtram‌ yatra yatra liṅgagrahaṇaṃ śrūyate anuvartate ca tatsarvaṃliṅnimittaṃ tatra kriyātipattivivakṣāyāṃ liṅ‌nimitte lṛṅ‌ kriyātipattau iti bhaviṣyatkāle nityaṃ lṛṅ‌ bhavati| bhūtātipattau ca kāle bhūte cetyanena sūtreṇa utāpyoḥ samarthayorliṅiti yāvat‌ bhūte kriyātipattau vibhāṣā lṛṅ‌bhavati| tataḥ parasmin‌ liṅ‌nimitte nityaṃ bhūtakriyātipattau lṛṅ‌ bhavati| tathā vidhinimantraṇāmantraṇādhīṣṭasampraśnaprārthaneṣu liṅ‌vidhānaṃ tatra vidhirniyogaḥ| kaṭaṃ bhavān‌ kuryāditi| nimantraṇaṃ niyogakaraṇam‌| asatyāmapi tadicchāyām‌| akaraṇe satyadharmotpatteḥ| niyamena avaśyambhāvena yatkaraṇaṃ tanniyogakaraṇam‌ iha bhuñjīta bhavāniti| āmantraṇaṃ kāmācāra icchāprakāraḥ tena yadāmantraṇam‌| etaduktaṃ bhavati yadicchayaiva karaṇaṃ nānicchayā| akaraṇe'pi doṣābhāvāt‌ tadāmantraṇamiti| iha bhavān‌ bhuñjīteti| adhīṣṭaḥ satkārapūrvako vyāpāraḥ sampraśnaḥ sampradhāraṇaṃ kartavyālocanā| kinnu khalu bho vyākaraṇamadhīyīya chando'dhīyīya iti vidhyādiṣu āśiṣi ca loḍvidhānam‌| tatra preṣaṇaṃ praiṣaḥ, kāmacārānujñā atisargaḥ, nimittabhūtasya kālasyāvasaraḥ prāptakālatā| āśiṣi ca liṅ‌vidhiḥ| māṅyupapade māṅi luṅiti luṅ‌vidhi smaśabdasahite māṅyupapade laṅ‌luṅau bhavataḥ| ityeṣā kālalakāranirṇayārthā dik‌|| bhvādiprakaraṇam‌ bhū sattāyām‌| udāttaḥ parasmaibhāṣaḥ| bhū ityayaṃ dhātuḥ sattāyāmarthe vartate| bhū iti sthite bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ (pā0sū0 1/3/1) bhū ityevamādayaḥ śabdāḥ kriyāvācino dhātusaṃjñā bhavanti| sādhyamānarūpā hi kriyā| sā ca pūrvāparībhūtāvayavā tatra pūrvāvayavo'dhiśrayaṇādirapara udakasekādiḥ pākakriyāyāḥ evamanyāsāmapi yadi pūrvāparībhūtāvayavā kriyā tadvācakaḥ śabdo dhātuḥ kathaṃ tarhi bhavaterarthasya kriyātvam‌| pūrvāparībhāvasyaivāsambhavāt‌| tathāhi bhavatirayaṃ sattārthaḥ| sattā ca nityā nityasya cākriyārūpatvāt‌ pauryāparyaṃ nāsti kathaṃ tadvācakasya dhātusaṃjñā, tathā abhāvo nāma vināśaḥ sa kathaṃ kriyā bhavet‌| nahi tasya paurvāparyamasti| kathaṃ tadvācakasya naśerdhātutvam‌| śvetasaṃyogāvapi guṇauguṇatvācca pauryāparyaṃ nāstīti kathaṃcit‌ kathaṃ yujeḥ saṃyujeśca dhātutvaṃ samavāyo'pi nityatvādakramatvācca| kriyātotyantabhinna eveti tadvācinaḥ samavapūrvasya iṇo na dhātutvamiti, ucyate iha vyākaraṇe sarva sādhanāyattodayamiti nityamapi vastu pūrvāparībhāvenocyamānaṃ kriyātvenāvabhāsate| ayamarthaḥ-sattāvataḥ padārthasyārthaḥ kriyāyāṃ pūrvāparībhāvena vyāpāropalambhāt‌ tadgatā sattāpi pūrvāparībhūtā buddhyā kalpyate| tannibandhanastasyāmapi kriyāvyavahāra evamabhāvādiṣvapi tathā vadanaikadeśe dravye'pi vartamānasya gaṇḍeḥ pūrvavaddhātutvam‌| tena gaṇḍa iti siddham‌| tathā bidi avayave iti avayave dravye'pi binduriti| athavā akriyāvācināmapi kriyāvāciṣu madhyepāṭhāddhātutvaṃ veditavyam‌| nanvaṅkuro jāyata iti kathamidaṃ, tathā hi prādurbhāvaḥ kartṛtvaṃ ceti dvitīyamiha na ghaṭate prādurbhāvohyasataḥ utpattiḥ kartṛtvaṃ ca sata iti parasparaṃ viruddhayoḥ karmaṇorekaṃ sandhitsate'nyat‌ prācyavata iti satyamekasya viruddhakarmadvayānusandhānaṃ na ghaṭate| atra tu dvayamasti| sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaśca tatrāṅkurasāmānyaṃ kartṛ tadviśiṣṭā ca vyaktiḥ| pūrvamasati jāyate antastatvagṛhītaḥ pūrvamadṛṣṭāṅkuraḥ kartā bāhyarūpatayā ca janma, janmani cābhūtaprādurbhāva eveti na vaktavyam‌ anyaḥ kartānyaśca bāhye jāyate| tato bhinnaviṣayatvādayuktamiti antastatvagṛhītasya bāhye naikatvādhyavasāyāt‌| tathāhi ya eva mayādhyavasitaḥ sa evāyaṃ dṛśyate bāhya iti| dṛśyavikalpayorekatvena vyavahāro dṛśyate| yathokta dṛśyavikalpārthāvekīkṛtya vyavahārapravṛtteriti satkāryavādināṃ tu mate kāraṇameva kāryarūpeṇa vipariṇamata iti yuktam‌| kartṛtvamaṅkurādeḥ kāraṇāvasthāyāmeva kāryasya śaktirūpeṇa vidyamānatvāt‌ āvirbhāvaśca janmārthaḥ| sa ca pūrvamapi sata eveti abhūtaprādurbhāvo janmāpi saṃgacchata eveti| evamaṅkuro bhavati athavā prakṛtivikāra-bhāvavivakṣāyāṃ tu cvipratyayaḥ bījamaṅkurībhavatīti| na khalvatyantamasata utpattiḥ prādurbhāvaḥ api tu jāyate viśeṣaṇopalabhyate| patrakāṇḍanālādibhāvena sphuṭībhavatītyarthaḥ| tathāhi prāhurbhāśabdaḥ prakāśe'bhidhānakāṇḍeṣu paṭhyate prakāśaśca sata eva bhavati| atoṅkurasyaiva kartṛtvamiti pūrvāparībhāvo hi janmanipātādi-kriyāvadvidyata iti sarvamanavadyam‌| sā ca kriyā dvividhā parispandanasādhanasādhyā aparispandanasādhanasādhyā| tatra parispandanasādhanasādhyo dhātvarthaḥ kriyetyucyate itarastu bhāva iti| sā punarapi dvividhā karmasthā kartṛsthā ceti| tatra karmasamavāyenotpadyamānā karmasthā kriyā kusūlaṃ bhinattīti| karmastho bhāvaḥ odanaṃ pacatīti| kartari samavetotpadyamānā kartṛsthā| gacchati grāmamiti kartṛsthā kriyā| āste śeta iti kartṛstho bhāvaḥ| bhū ityetasya dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ kriyāpradhānatvārthaviśeṣaṇāya kālakārakaviśeṣa-vivakṣāyāṃ tāvadvartamānakāla upatiṣṭhate| pratyayārthatvena kartā ca tato dhātoḥ (pā0sū0 3/1/90) ityadhikṛtya vartamāne laṭ‌ (pā0sū0 3/2/023)| kaśca vartamānaḥ prārabdhāparisamāptaśca vartamānastasmin‌ vartamāne'rthe vartamānāddhātoḥ laṭ‌pratyayo bhavati| kartari kṛt‌ (pā0sū0 3/4/67) ityadhikṛtya laḥ karmaṇi prayojanam‌| āmaśca pratiṣedhārthamekācaścetyupagrahāt‌|| asyāyamarthaḥ| ūrṇuñ chādane ityasya ṇu stavane ityanena tulyatvaṃ vācyamityarthaḥ| kiṃ prayojanam‌ yaṅ‌prasiddhiḥ prayojanam‌ dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅityanena ekāco halāde kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ‌ kriyate nautistu ekāc‌ halādiśca tataśca yaṅ‌ prāpnoti| tasmādūrṇoterapi yaṅ‌siddhaye ṇuvadbhāvo vācyaḥ kiñcānyaccāpi prayojanaṃ ijādeśca gurumato'nṛccha iti ijādergurumatorām‌ pratyayo vidhīyate liṭi parataḥ ūrṇotiśca gurumān‌ ijādiśca tata āmpratyayaḥ prāpnoti atastatpretiṣedhāya dhātorṇuvadbhāvo vācyaḥ| anyadapi prayojanamasti ekācaśceḍupagrahāt‌ iḍupagrahāditi lyablope pañcamī prāsādāt‌ prekṣata ityādivat‌ karmaṇi lyablope pañcamī vaktavyetyanena iḍupagrahaḥ iṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ iṭ‌pratiṣedhaṃ samīkṣya ṇuvadbhāvo vācyaṃ ityarthaḥ| nanu ca nautyūrṇotī dvāvapi seṭāveva tathā hyaniṭ‌kārikāyāmukārānteṣu dvau paṭhitāveva ūrṇotimathoyanukṣṇuva iti| tat‌ kathaṃ nautitulyatayā ūrṇoteraniṭ‌tvaṃ pratipādyate siddhamasiddhena sādhyate| naiṣa doṣaḥ yo'yamiṭ‌pratiṣedhārthoṇuvadbhāvaḥ satu sāmānyaviṣayo na bhavati api tu viśeṣaniṣayaḥ| śryu kitītyanena ekāca ityadhikārādigantasyaikācaḥ kitsu iṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate yauteryathā bhavati nunutavāniti ūrṇutavānityatrāpi yathā syādityevamapi ṇuvadbhāve vācya ityarthaḥ|| iti hariyoginā viracitaṃ śābdikābharaṇaṃ saṃpūrṇam‌| śablukau śluśyanau śnuśśa śnamuśnā svārthaṇica tathā| iti vaikaraṇā bhedā daśa tiṅ‌pratyaye śapo|| viśiṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ vācya ūrṇoṇuvadbhāvo yaṅ‌prasiddhiḥ prayojanam‌| āmaśca pratiṣedhārthamekācaścetyupagrahāt‌|| asyāyamarthaḥ| ūrṇuñ
